_comment: Sonnet for most tasks. Reasonable limits, good quality-to-cost ratio.
"sonnet" is Sonnet 5.5 on the Anthropic API but Sonnet 4.5 ($3/$15, 200K) on Bedrock, Google Cloud and Foundry -- pin claude-sonnet-5-5 (Bedrock: anthropic.claude-sonnet-5-5) there.
Best for: most teams, daily development, standard feature work.
Read(...) deny rules keep Claude's file tools out of deps, build output and secrets (.claudeignore is not a Claude Code feature).

hooks.command: echo 'Session paused - review token usage with /usage'
